questions.question: How many projects should you pin on your GitHub profile?
questions.explanation: Pin 3-6 of your best projects — choose ones that show different skills (frontend, backend, AI, data).

questions.question: What does ATS stand for in job applications?
questions.explanation: ATS = Applicant Tracking System — software that scans resumes before humans review them.

questions.question: What is the best format for a fresher's resume?
questions.explanation: Freshers should have a 1-page resume in simple format (PDF) — ATS-friendly with keywords from the job post.

questions.question: Which platform is best for finding your first freelance gig?
questions.explanation: Fiverr is beginner-friendly — create a gig, start with a low price, and build reviews quickly.

questions.question: What should every pinned GitHub project have?
options: README with screenshot, tech stack, and setup instructions
Just a link to the live site
questions.explanation: Every project needs a README with: title, screenshot, tech stack, installation steps, and live demo link.

questions.question: What is a good LinkedIn headline for a developer?
options: Full-Stack Developer | Python, FastAPI, React | Building AI-powered apps
questions.explanation: Use the formula: Role | Key Skills | What You Build. Be specific about what you do.

questions.question: How should you describe a project on your resume?
options: Built a REST API with 15+ endpoints using FastAPI and PostgreSQL
questions.explanation: Use: Action verb + what you built + tech used + measurable result. Be specific and quantify.

questions.question: How many jobs should you apply to daily when job hunting?
options: Only when you feel like it
questions.explanation: Apply to 5-10 jobs daily, customize your resume for each role, and follow up after 3-5 days.

questions.question: What should your '60-second pitch' include?
options: Name, education, key skills, best project, and what you're looking for
Just your name and salary expectation
A joke to break the ice
questions.explanation: 60-second pitch = Name → Education → Skills → Best project → What you want. Keep it focused and confident.

questions.question: What makes a fresher stand out to employers?
options: Real projects on GitHub + matching skills + good communication
questions.explanation: Projects prove you can do the work. Match your skills to the job, communicate clearly, and show initiative.
